rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an audio recording or the act of recording sound.

example.english: I made a recording of the whole lecture and listened to it again at home.
example.traditional: 我用錄音錄低咗成個講座，返屋企再聽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 luk6 jam1 luk6 dai1 zo2 seng4 go3 gong2 zo6 faan1 uk1 kei2 zoi3 teng1

rows.note: Use this instead of 錄音 when the recording is visual, such as a TV programme or video.

example.english: I made a recording on my phone of the moment the bird flew away.
example.traditional: 我用部手機錄影，影低隻雀飛走嗰一刻。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 bou6 sau2 gei1 luk6 jing2 jing2 dai1 zek3 zoek3 fei1 zau2 go2 jat1 hak1
